chunks: We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Sa'd bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Khalid, from Isma'il bin Mahran, from Ayman bin Mahraz, from Mu'awiya bin Wahb, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, who said:

Hasan bin Ali, peace be upon them both, was among a group of his companions at the presence of Mu'awiya, and he said to him: O father of Muhammad, inform me about manliness (al-muru'ah). He said: A man's preservation of his religion, his act of rectifying his land/estate, his good manner during quarreling/disputes, the spreading of peace, the leniency of speech, maintaining abstinence/restraint, and endearment to people.

key_terms.إِصْلَاحُ الضَّيْعَة: Rectifying the estate/land; effectively managing one's property or wealth.
key_terms.إِفْشَاءُ السَّلَام: Spreading peace; actively greeting and promoting peace among people.
key_terms.التَّحَبُّب: Endearment; making oneself lovable and approachable to others.
key_terms.الْكَفّ: Restraint/abstinence; holding back from excess or inappropriate actions.
key_terms.الْمُرُوءَة: Manliness, virtue, or chivalry; a comprehensive concept of moral excellence and social grace.
key_terms.حُسْنُ الْمُنَازَعَة: Good manner in dispute; conducting oneself with grace during conflicts or arguments.
key_terms.حِفْظُ الدِّين: Preservation of religion; maintaining one's faith and religious duties.
key_terms.لِينُ الْكَلَام: Leniency/gentleness of speech; using soft and kind words.

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic definition of manliness (muru'ah) according to Imam Hasan?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Hasan (AS) redefines *al-muru'ah* (virtuous manliness) as a holistic ethical framework rather than mere physical prowess, emphasizing the preservation of faith alongside social responsibility. This definition reflects the Shia emphasis on integrating spiritual integrity with practical social conduct, such as dignified dispute resolution and gentle speech, which are essential for maintaining communal harmony. The inclusion of 'managing one's estate' highlights the importance of financial stewardship as a component of moral character.

en.basel-kadem: 3.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammed bin Khalid, from Isma’eel bin Mahran, from Ayman bin Muhriz, from Mu’awiya bin Wahab, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, that he said:

Hasan bin Ali, peace be upon them both, was among a group of his companions at the presence of Mu’awiya, and he said to him: O father of Muhammed, inform me about manliness. He said: A man’s preservation of his religion, his act of rectifying his land, his good manner during quarreling, the spreading of peace, the leniency of speech, maintaining abstinence and endearment to people.
